policy: Do not update locked hashes or rules unless the user explicitly approves changing that protected behavior.

japan_rule.input_model: First page already displays +; user enters international digits. Japan numbers must start with 81.
japan_rule.meaning_of_zero_tolerance: 0 is international mobile part; 1 is normal domestic trunk 0; 2-3 tolerate up to two extra leading zeroes.

phone_validation.canonical_output: Use libphonenumber PhoneNumber.isValid() when available and return PhoneNumber.number without +, so domestic trunk zeroes after the calling code are removed from E.164 output.

キャセイパシフィック航空ご利用のお客様へ
お預けの荷物がX線検査を通過できず、再検査が必要です。出国審査前は至急カウンター4へ、出国審査後は搭乗ゲートスタッフへお申し出ください。対応されない場合、荷物を搭載できない可能性がございます。ご協力をお願いいたします。
japanese_sms.routing: Scenario 1 Japanese, Scenario 2 Join Japanese, and Scenario 2 Transit Japanese use native SMS; Chinese/English use WhatsApp.
japanese_sms.suffix_policy: No flight/SEC/date suffix for Japanese SMS.
japanese_sms.transit_time_policy: Only Scenario 2 Transit Japanese includes current Taipei time via Asia/Taipei in HH:mm.

scenario2.join_flight_rule: CX fixed; approved general CX whitelist from flight_rules_v114.
scenario2.call_direct_rule: Same call-only behavior as former No message; open WhatsApp with no text body.
scenario2.ui_policy: Passenger Type page keeps existing layout; no icons; Join/Transit/Call labels use brand teal. Join/Transit display labels include “& Message”.
scenario2.destination_display_policy: Call Passenger confirmation/preview Destination row uses IATA airport codes only; approved message copy continues to use full localized destination names.

protected.ui_language_heading: All four scenarios use the heading 'Language'.
protected.scenario3_languages: Chinese/English only; Japanese option removed per user request.

scenario1_passenger_type.call_directly: Same call-only WhatsApp logic as Scenario 2; no message.

您好：這裡是國泰航空桃園機場辦公室。

由於您的寄艙行李未能通過桃園機場的轉機X 光安全檢查。因此，您的行李目前暫時留在

scenario1_transit_copy.en:
Hello, this is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

Your checked baggage did not pass the transfer X-ray security screening and is currently being held at the screening area.

Please return to the boarding gate as soon as possible and contact our staff for assistance, so we can arrange for your baggage to be loaded before departure.

Thank you for your cooperation.

datetime.policy: Both dateCode() and taipeiTime() are based on Asia/Taipei.

functional_fixes_v116.service_worker: ASSETS is explicitly declared; APP_VERSION is v1.0.16; local libphonenumber-js 1.12.29 is precached; cache revision r3 forces the UI/state hotfix to refresh.
functional_fixes_v116.transit_sec_ui: Scenario 2 Final Call SEC page was explicitly removed for Join and Transit; Scenario 1 retains SEC origin UI.
functional_fixes_v116.scenario_entry_language_reset: Scenario 3 resets to Chinese First; Scenario 4 resets to English First; scenario re-entry also clears stale case fields.
functional_fixes_v116.scenario4_airline_designator: Connecting flight and Protect to accept exactly two alphanumeric IATA designator characters.

state_navigation_hotfix_v116.policy: Back/Next within the same flow preserves inputs. Re-entering a scenario from the Scenario screen starts that scenario clean. Changing Passenger Type clears fields that belong to the previous type.
state_navigation_hotfix_v116.scenario1: Re-entry clears Flight/SEC. Join↔Transit/Direct type changes clear Scenario 1 Flight/SEC; reselecting the same type after Back preserves them.
state_navigation_hotfix_v116.scenario2: Re-entry clears Flight/SEC/Gate. Join↔Transit/Direct type changes clear Flight/SEC/Gate; reselecting the same type after Back preserves them.
state_navigation_hotfix_v116.scenario3: Re-entry clears Arrival Flight and both baggage tags.
state_navigation_hotfix_v116.scenario4: Re-entry clears disrupted/connecting/protect flight fields, status/arrangement choices, and times.
state_navigation_hotfix_v116.progress: Scenario 2 Join/Transit use a stable four-step Final Call flow after authorized SEC-page removal. Call Directly preview hides the progress bar.
state_navigation_hotfix_v116.preview_draft: Opening a read-only message preview and navigating Back does not create a custom draft. Actual typed edits are still preserved per language.
state_navigation_hotfix_v116.blocked_warning: Both canned-number blacklist entries surface 罐頭號碼 無用 even when libphonenumber regards the exact number as invalid.
